off.title: Automatic updates are off in this build
off.detail: {{appName}} doesn't check for or install updates. Rebuild it from source to update.

auto.label: Automatic updates
auto.hint: Download in the background and install when you quit

coexistence.title: Don't run both versions at once
coexistence.detail: The official NexQ and {{appName}} interfere when they run at the same time: the one launched second can't register the global shortcuts, and both show meeting-detection prompts.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: {{appName}} keeps a log on this computer to help diagnose problems. API keys are removed automatically; attach it when you report an issue.

verbose.label: Verbose logging
verbose.hint: Records more detail while you reproduce a problem. Turn it off afterwards.

about.footer: {{appName}} is an open desktop application. All processing can run locally with Ollama or LM Studio, or optionally connect to cloud AI providers.

toast.restartOrQuit: Restart from the footer, or it installs when you quit.
toast.restartToInstall: Restart from the footer to install.

restartDialog.title: End meeting and update?
restartDialog.message: Your meeting will be saved, then {{appName}} restarts on the new version.

errors.meetingNotSaved: Couldn't finish saving the meeting. Update postponed.
